scheduler.workers.sectionSubtitle: Track skills, role fit, and availability to place the right people in the right shifts.
scheduler.workers.emptyDesc: Add 2–3 people to unlock auto-assign and scheduling.
scheduler.workers.addCardSubtitle: Create a worker profile with role and skills.
scheduler.workers.addedSuccess: {name} added — set their availability to enable shift scheduling.
scheduler.workers.addCardTooltip: Fill in the worker's name, role (e.g. "Barista"), and any skills (comma-separated). Their ID is auto-generated. After saving, scroll to "Availability intake" to set when they can work.
scheduler.workers.tooltip: 👷 Workers are the heart of your roster. Add a name, role (e.g. "Barista"), and skills. Once saved, scroll down to set their weekly availability so the scheduler knows when they can work.
scheduler.availability.sectionSubtitle: Capture recent changes before building rosters.
scheduler.availability.assignNowHint: Scrolls to the shift creation section
scheduler.availability.tooltip: 📅 Availability tells the scheduler when each worker can work. Use Mon–Sun abbreviations and 24h time (09:00–17:00). The auto-assign engine only places workers in shifts that fit their availability windows.
scheduler.templates.sectionSubtitle: Standardize start/end times and coverage expectations by role.
scheduler.templates.emptyDesc: Templates let you build a full roster in one tap.
scheduler.templates.addCardSubtitle: Define a reusable shift with role, time window, and minimum coverage.
scheduler.templates.nameA11yHint: A short name for this shift template
scheduler.templates.savedSuccess: "{name}" template saved! You can now auto-assign workers to this shift.
scheduler.templates.addCardTooltip: Give the template a name (e.g. "Morning"), select a role, set the time window (24h format), and enter the minimum number of workers needed. Templates are the building blocks of auto-assign.
scheduler.templates.tooltip: 🗂 Templates are reusable shift blueprints. Define "Morning Support 09:00–17:00, 1 worker needed" once and reuse it every week. Templates drive the auto-assign engine — the more you add, the smarter the suggestions.
scheduler.shifts.sectionSubtitle: Assign workers into templates for specific dates.
scheduler.shifts.autoAssignA11y: Auto-assign workers to all templates for this date
scheduler.shifts.tooltip: 📋 Once you have workers and templates, create individual shifts here. Enter the date, pick the worker and template, then save. Or use Auto-assign to fill all templates in one tap — it respects availability, role match, and fairness.
scheduler.demand.sectionSubtitle: Define expected demand and staffing gaps by role.
scheduler.demand.quickSetupDesc: Seed baseline demand when historical shifts or external signals are unavailable.
scheduler.demand.noForecastData: No historical shifts or external signals found. Use quick setup to seed demand targets.

scheduler.demand.forecastHelperNoData: No historical shifts or external signals found. Use quick setup to seed demand targets.

scheduler.demand.forecastHelperPending: Waiting for input to settle before forecasting…
scheduler.demand.forecastHelperReady: Ready to run forecast with today's signals.
scheduler.demand.lostRevenueDesc: Estimated revenue at risk from uncovered roles before vs. after forecasting.
scheduler.demand.posTargetsSaved: {n} demand targets saved from POS data.
scheduler.demand.tooltip: 📈 Demand targets tell the scheduler how many workers you need per role per day. Start with "Quick setup" to seed a week of baseline demand, then run a forecast to get AI-powered targets based on your historical shifts and external signals.
scheduler.demand.posTooltip: Upload POS sales CSV to automatically calculate how many workers you need per day. The engine uses a rolling average to smooth revenue and converts it to required headcount using your revenue-per-worker-hour target.
scheduler.demand.posMixDesc: Set how many workers you need per role based on expected covers or revenue.
scheduler.demand.posNoRoles: Add at least one role to generate forecasts.
scheduler.demand.posCoversWarning: No covers data in CSV — using revenue estimate for cover-ratio roles.
scheduler.demand.posCsvA11yHint: Paste CSV with columns: date, revenue, covers, notes

scheduler.roster.gaps.title: Staffing gaps
scheduler.roster.gaps.subtitle: Highlight under-covered roles across the horizon.
scheduler.roster.tooltip: 🗓 Your live roster calendar. Shifts appear as soon as you save them. Click "Publish" to lock a shift in, then "Notify" to alert the worker. Published shifts feed the Analytics tab with hours and coverage data.
scheduler.pos.sectionSubtitle: Upload CSV revenue data to enrich demand forecasting.
scheduler.pos.tooltip: 💰 Upload your Point-of-Sale sales data (CSV) to unlock smarter forecasts. The engine uses day-of-week seasonality, revenue trends, and revenue-per-worker efficiency to predict demand more accurately. Accepts: date, revenue, covers (optional), notes (optional).
scheduler.pos.csvHelp: Accepted format: date (YYYY-MM-DD), revenue (number), covers (optional integer), notes (optional text). Up to 1,000 rows per upload.
scheduler.pos.dropHint: Drag & drop a .csv file here, or tap to browse

analytics.subtitle: Scheduling performance at a glance.
analytics.tooltip: 📊 Real-time scheduling metrics. Coverage rate shows how much demand you're filling. Revenue at risk estimates what uncovered slots cost you. Worker hours tracks fairness across your team. Check this tab after publishing shifts.

tour.roleSelect.title: Who are you?
tour.roleSelect.desc: Tell us your role so we can personalise your tour and surface the features that matter most to you right away.
tour.roleSelect.managerDesc: Build schedules, manage your team, forecast demand, and keep labour costs under control.
tour.roleSelect.workerDesc: View your shifts, set your availability, and stay in sync with your team — all in one place.
tour.nav.actionPrompt: Complete the step above to continue ↑
tour.manager.step1.title: Welcome to Your Command Centre
tour.manager.step1.desc: This is your Home dashboard — a live snapshot of today's coverage, pending approvals, and team activity the moment you log in.
tour.manager.step1.why: Managers who review their dashboard daily catch coverage gaps before they become costly call-outs. Starting here keeps your entire operation visible at a glance.
tour.manager.step2.title: Build Your Scheduling Streak
tour.manager.step2.desc: Your streak tracks how consistently you publish schedules on time, giving your team the advance notice they need to plan their lives.
tour.manager.step2.why: Research from 7shifts shows that teams given schedules at least one week in advance experience up to 40% fewer no-shows — your streak makes that habit stick.
tour.manager.step3.title: Meet the Scheduler
tour.manager.step3.desc: The Scheduler tab is where you build, edit, and publish weekly rosters using a drag-and-drop visual timeline for every role and location.
tour.manager.step3.why: A centralised visual scheduler eliminates double-bookings and reduces the back-and-forth emails that steal hours from your week.
tour.manager.step4.title: Add Your First Team Member
tour.manager.step4.desc: Invite a worker by entering their name and contact details so Horario can match them to shifts and send automatic notifications.
tour.manager.step4.why: Getting your roster into the system unlocks auto-scheduling, conflict detection, and real-time coverage alerts that save managers an average of 5 hours per week.
tour.manager.step5.title: Capture Team Availability
tour.manager.step5.desc: Set or review availability windows for your team members so the scheduler only offers shifts they can actually work.
tour.manager.step5.why: Scheduling against confirmed availability is the single biggest driver of shift acceptance rates — teams using Horario see up to 35% fewer swap requests when availability is set upfront.
tour.manager.step5.action: Set availability for a team member above ↑
tour.manager.step6.title: Create a Shift Template
tour.manager.step6.desc: Save a reusable shift template — name, role, start time, and duration — so you can drop consistent shifts onto the calendar in seconds.
tour.manager.step6.why: Templates reduce schedule-build time by up to 60% by removing repetitive data entry, letting you focus on optimising coverage rather than re-typing the same shifts every week.
tour.manager.step6.action: Create your first shift template above ↑
tour.manager.step7.title: Assign Your First Shift
tour.manager.step7.desc: Drag your new template onto the timeline or tap a cell to assign a shift to a team member for an upcoming day.
tour.manager.step7.why: Publishing even one assigned shift activates Horario's notification pipeline, so your team immediately experiences the reliability that drives higher engagement and retention.
tour.manager.step7.action: Assign a shift to a team member above ↑
tour.manager.step8.title: Forecast Demand Like a Pro
tour.manager.step8.desc: Horario analyses historical traffic, sales, and headcount data to recommend optimal staffing levels before you even open the scheduler.
tour.manager.step8.why: Demand-informed scheduling helps operators cut excess labour costs by an average of 15% while maintaining service quality — you now have everything you need to schedule smarter from day one.
tour.worker.step1.title: Welcome to Your Schedule Hub
tour.worker.step1.desc: This is your Home screen — see your next shift, any open messages from your manager, and your team's live roster the moment you open the app.
tour.worker.step1.why: Having your schedule and communications in one place means no more missed shifts from lost text threads or forgotten paper printouts.
tour.worker.step2.title: Grow Your Reliability Streak
tour.worker.step2.desc: Your streak reflects how consistently you keep your availability up to date, helping your manager schedule you for shifts that actually fit your life.
tour.worker.step2.why: Workers with complete, current availability profiles receive more preferred shifts and are first in line when extra hours become available.
tour.worker.step3.title: See the Full Team Schedule
tour.worker.step3.desc: The Scheduler tab shows the published roster for your location so you always know who you're working with and can plan around your colleagues' shifts.
tour.worker.step3.why: Visibility into the full team schedule makes shift swaps faster and reduces the confusion that leads to understaffed days and stressful surprises.
tour.worker.step4.title: Set Your Availability Now
tour.worker.step4.desc: Tell your manager exactly when you're available to work so every shift you're offered is one you can genuinely accept.
tour.worker.step4.why: Teams using Horario report 35% fewer last-minute conflicts when all members set their availability upfront — your input directly improves the whole team's schedule quality.
tour.worker.step5.title: You're Ready to Roll
tour.worker.step5.desc: You've explored your dashboard, learned about streaks, seen the team schedule, and locked in your availability — your scheduling experience starts strong from here.
tour.worker.step5.why: Workers who complete onboarding are significantly more confident managing shift changes, requesting time off, and communicating with their team entirely inside Horario.
tour.completed.title: 🎉 You're all set!
tour.completed.desc: You've completed the tour and have everything you need to build smarter schedules, reduce no-shows, and keep your team in sync. Your first great week starts now.
tour.completed.seedConfirmation: ✅ Sample data added — explore your first team, templates, and shifts!
